credit.notes: Customer service page: 'Block your Credit Card - Call us on 1800 10 888'. Card controls also available in the IDFC FIRST Bank mobile app and netbanking.

debit.notes: Customer service page: 'Block your Debit Card - Call us on 1800 266 9970'. Card controls also available in the IDFC FIRST Bank mobile app and netbanking.

upi.notes: No in-app UPI lock menu path, netbanking UPI manage path, SMS keyword, or WhatsApp UPI-block service is published on the bank's own pages. UPI T&C (terms-and-conditions/upi-solutions): 'The user has to immediately bring it to the notice of IDFC FIRST Bank in case he/she suspects that his / her Mobile number is / has been allotted/ used by another person and/or notices unauthorized transactions in his / her accounts and make sure that the facility is deregistered for his / her mobile no.'; 'Entering the wrong mPIN thrice will block the UPI facility where the linked account belongs to IDFC FIRST bank'; registration is auto-suspended if the facility has not been accessed for 180 days or more. Emergency path: call customer care 1800 10 888 (24x7, 'For Accounts, Credit Cards, Loans, and Other banking services') to have the UPI facility deregistered, or file under 'Report any UNAUTH Transaction' -> 'Steps to Report Unauthorised transaction -> Click here' (/customer-care-sr/raise-a-request). androidApp/iosApp resolved 2026-11-01 by following the bank's own download link idfcnetbanking.onelink.me/p1bD/1jq39swv published in the site footer.
